# hg eval

**What this page tells you:** every `hg eval` subcommand, with its arguments, flags and defaults.

Run the repo's eval suite; publish and read back results.

## Synopsis

```text
hg eval [flags]
hg eval publish [flags]
hg eval results <component> [flags]
hg eval prove [flags]
```

`--json` prints one JSON document on stdout; narration goes to stderr.

## `hg eval `

```text
hg eval [flags]
```

Run the repo's optional deterministic eval suite against the deployed profiles.

Suite schema: `cli/schemas/evals/` (see the contract reference).

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--dir` | `<repo-or-evals-dir>` | — | The repo (or its `evals/` directory) holding the suite. |
| `--profile` | `<name>` | — | Narrow to one profile; default is every onboarded profile. |
| `--scenario` | `<name>` | — | Run one scenario only. |
| `--repeat` | `<n>` | `1` | Repeat the suite N times. |
| `--timeout` | `<seconds>` | `300` | Per-scenario timeout. |
| `--allow-repo-scripts` | — | — | Permit repo-provided scripts to execute. |

**Examples**

```bash
hg eval --dir ./evals
hg eval --dir ../persona --scenario greets --repeat 3
```

## `hg eval publish`

```text
hg eval publish [flags]
```

Publish a run's report to the control plane's eval store.

Token from `HG_EVAL_TOKEN` or `--token-file`, never argv; an Access-guarded edge needs `HG_CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_ID`/`_SECRET` too.

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--control-plane` | `<url>` | — | Base URL of the control plane (the exposed Nexus). |
| `--report` | `<report.json>` | — | The run report to publish (default: the newest local run). |
| `--component` | `<id>` | — | Component id the results are recorded under. |
| `--token-file` | `<path>` | — | File holding the publish token — a FILE, never the token itself: argv is world-readable through /proc. |

## `hg eval results`

```text
hg eval results <component> [flags]
```

Read back the published results for a component.

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--control-plane` | `<url>` | — | Base URL of the control plane (the exposed Nexus). |
| `--suite` | `<name>` | — | Narrow to one suite. |
| `--scenario` | `<name>` | — | Narrow to one scenario. |
| `--limit` | `<n>` | `50` | Maximum rows returned. |

## `hg eval prove`

```text
hg eval prove [flags]
```

Evalpub001..004: anonymous publish refused, forged token refused, readback complete, no credential material served.

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--control-plane` | `<url>` | — | Base URL of the control plane (the exposed Nexus). |
| `--component` | `<id>` | — | Component to prove against. |
